\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 212-215 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R220-first-pass-words-from-chapters-212-215}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a programme and a film.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item weak, selfish, generous, well-behaved, ugly
  \item a cupboard, electricity, rubbish, toothpaste, a toothbrush
  \item buttermilk, fruit juice, tender coconut water, flour; batter, bread
  \item a pencil, a dictionary, a fee, a letter, an envelope; a cover
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Weak? (\textbf{\ta{பலவீனமான}}, \emph{palavīṉamāṉa}.) Selfish? (\textbf{\ta{சுயநலமான}}, \emph{cuyanalamāṉa}.) Generous? (\textbf{\ta{பெருந்தன்மையான}}, \emph{peruntaṉmaiyāṉa}.) Well-behaved? (\textbf{\ta{ஒழுக்கமான}}, \emph{oḻukkamāṉa}.) Ugly? (\textbf{\ta{அசிங்கமான}}, \emph{aciṅkamāṉa}.) A cupboard? (\textbf{\ta{அலமாரி}}, \emph{alamāri}.) Electricity? (\textbf{\ta{மின்சாரம்}}, \emph{miṉcāram}.) Rubbish? (\textbf{\ta{குப்பை}}, \emph{kuppai}.) Toothpaste? (\textbf{\ta{பற்பசை}}, \emph{paṟpacai}.) A toothbrush? (\textbf{\ta{பல்துலக்கி}}, \emph{paltulakki}.) Buttermilk? (\textbf{\ta{மோர்}}, \emph{mōr}.) Fruit juice? (\textbf{\ta{பழச்சாறு}}, \emph{paḻaccāṟu}.) Tender coconut water? (\textbf{\ta{இளநீர்}}, \emph{iḷanīr}.) Flour; batter? (\textbf{\ta{மாவு}}, \emph{māvu}.) Bread? (\textbf{\ta{ரொட்டி}}, \emph{roṭṭi}.) A pencil? (\textbf{\ta{பென்சில்}}, \emph{peṉcil}.) A dictionary? (\textbf{\ta{அகராதி}}, \emph{akarāti}.) A fee? (\textbf{\ta{கட்டணம்}}, \emph{kaṭṭaṇam}.) A letter? (\textbf{\ta{கடிதம்}}, \emph{kaṭitam}.) An envelope; a cover? (\textbf{\ta{உறை}}, \emph{uṟai}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 216-220 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R220-second-pass-words-from-chapters-216-220}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for the internet and a password.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item the internet, a password, a newspaper, a ticket; a slip of paper, a map
  \item a bride, a bridegroom, an engagement, a feast, a festival
  \item a giraffe, a zebra, a crocodile, a butterfly, a bee
  \item bamboo, a rainbow, fog, a gentle breeze, a flood
  \item a keyboard, a camera, the radio, a programme, a film
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
The internet? (\textbf{\ta{இணையம்}}, \emph{iṇaiyam}.) A password? (\textbf{\ta{கடவுச்சொல்}}, \emph{kaṭavuccol}.) A newspaper? (\textbf{\ta{நாளிதழ்}}, \emph{nāḷitaḻ}.) A ticket; a slip of paper? (\textbf{\ta{சீட்டு}}, \emph{cīṭṭu}.) A map? (\textbf{\ta{வரைபடம்}}, \emph{varaipaṭam}.) A bride? (\textbf{\ta{மணமகள்}}, \emph{maṇamakaḷ}.) A bridegroom? (\textbf{\ta{மணமகன்}}, \emph{maṇamakaṉ}.) An engagement? (\textbf{\ta{நிச்சயதார்த்தம்}}, \emph{niccayatārttam}.) A feast? (\textbf{\ta{விருந்து}}, \emph{viruntu}.) A festival? (\textbf{\ta{விழா}}, \emph{viḻā}.) A giraffe? (\textbf{\ta{ஒட்டகச்சிவிங்கி}}, \emph{oṭṭakacciviṅki}.) A zebra? (\textbf{\ta{வரிக்குதிரை}}, \emph{varikkutirai}.) A crocodile? (\textbf{\ta{முதலை}}, \emph{mutalai}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{\ta{பட்டாம்பூச்சி}}, \emph{paṭṭāmpūcci}.) A bee? (\textbf{\ta{தேனீ}}, \emph{tēṉī}.) Bamboo? (\textbf{\ta{மூங்கில்}}, \emph{mūṅkil}.) A rainbow? (\textbf{\ta{வானவில்}}, \emph{vāṉavil}.) Fog? (\textbf{\ta{மூடுபனி}}, \emph{mūṭupaṉi}.) A gentle breeze? (\textbf{\ta{தென்றல்}}, \emph{teṉṟal}.) A flood? (\textbf{\ta{வெள்ளம்}}, \emph{veḷḷam}.) A keyboard? (\textbf{\ta{விசைப்பலகை}}, \emph{vicaippalakai}.) A camera? (\textbf{\ta{கேமரா}}, \emph{kēmarā}.) The radio? (\textbf{\ta{வானொலி}}, \emph{vāṉoli}.) A programme? (\textbf{\ta{நிகழ்ச்சி}}, \emph{nikaḻcci}.) A film? (\textbf{\ta{திரைப்படம்}}, \emph{tiraippaṭam}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
